difficulty_reason: The author turns model isotropy dynamics into antidevelopment and trivial holonomy on an invariant region, then extends the developing map across a codimension-two exceptional set. Explicit projective, quaternionic and CR isotropy calculations yield dense-open geometric embeddings and compact rigidity. The three applications share the new holonomy construction and are kept together as one problem unit, with all four original proof illustrations and support retained.
